problem: The live pricing page could render and pricing taps could respond while English switching still failed because the browser called /api/i18n-translate and Netlify returned 404.
root_cause: Production CSP blocks inline pricing JavaScript, and the V18 build pipeline rewrote prijzen.html after source capture. pricing-build-integrity restored only the pricing section, not the critical external runtime, so the final deploy could render controls without an executable controller. Separately, /api/i18n-translate lacked an explicit Netlify rewrite.
prevention: Critical pricing interactions run from a self-hosted external script allowed by CSP.
pricing-build-integrity must re-inject and assert exactly one pricing runtime after all V18 transforms.
Use a new versioned asset URL for pricing runtime changes to avoid Safari/CDN stale-script reuse.
Netlify explicitly routes /api/i18n-translate to the i18n-translate function.
Website CI executes real mobile taps and English switching on the exact Netlify preview with Functions.
